# Bunny: white fur, long ears, a pink nose, dark eyes, 0.86 m tall. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Fur --base-color 0.9922 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Nose --base-color 0.9843 0.2784 0.4431 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.3255 0.0118 0.2941 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.2 --location 0.000 0.000 0.200
scale 1 0.95 1.05
apply --scale
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.16 --location 0.000 -0.030 0.460
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name Tail --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location 0.000 0.200 0.160
material assign Fur
add mesh cube --name EarL --size 1 --location -0.088 -0.020 0.720
scale 0.09 0.06 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -10 0
apply --rotation
material assign Fur
add mesh cube --name EarR --size 1 --location 0.088 -0.020 0.720
scale 0.09 0.06 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 10 0
apply --rotation
material assign Fur
add mesh cube --name Nose --size 0.06 --location 0.000 -0.190 0.440
material assign Nose
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 0.06 --location -0.065 -0.150 0.500
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 0.06 --location 0.065 -0.150 0.500
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export bunny.glb
